name: Gemini 2.5 Pro
description: Google's most advanced thinking model with a 1M token context.
longDescription: Gemini 2.5 Pro is Google's most capable AI model, featuring native "thinking" capabilities for enhanced reasoning. With a massive 1M token context window, it excels at complex coding, math, and data analysis, ranking #1 on multiple LLM benchmarks.

from google import genai

client = genai.Client()

    contents="Hello!"
)
print(response.text)
